title: The Fourth, 2017 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The morning after the lockbox Fourth: the dock swept, and the strangers gone into their rentals, and Gully counting the coffee cups in the bin — forty — and saying that's forty coffees. Wood says that's forty people. Gully says same thing. The strip disagrees quietly, in the panel widths.

panels.composition: The dock in the morning. GULLY with a bin of paper cups, counting. WOOD on the steps. The PUP.
